description: Opening turn: P1 sees P2 holding W1 alongside higher ranks. With belief graph, it should prioritize a rank-1 clue to unlock the guaranteed playable 1; without it, a color clue to a non-playable card is likely and wastes tempo.
belief_graph_summary: Tracks teammate hand state from the start and prioritizes PLAY_ONES, so it knows surfacing the only rank-1 (W1) is the highest-value clue.

with_belief_expected_hint.rationale: Belief graph prioritizes PLAY_ONES; unique rank-1 clue immediately enables the W1 play and starts fireworks.

without_belief_redundant_hint.rationale: No modeled teammate knowledge, so agent may highlight green cards (G2/G4) that are unplayable, giving low-value information.

description: Midgame: P2 considers P1's hand after multiple prior clues. P1 already knows their rank-1s; the urgent new info is B1. With belief graph, agent should clue B to unlock B1; without belief, it repeats a rank-1 clue P1 already received.
history_summary: Turn2: P2 gave rank-1 clue to P1
Turn4: P2 gave color-Y clue to P1
Turn6: P2 gave color-W clue to P1

known_teammate_knowledge: P1 knows yellow and white from earlier color clues

belief_graph_summary: Carries forward prior rank/color clues to infer P1 already knows their 1s, so the only new, high-impact info is the blue color to surface B1.

with_belief_expected_hint.rationale: Belief graph tracks that P1 knows their 1s; new, high-value info is B color to surface the B1 play and advance fireworks.

without_belief_redundant_hint.rationale: Without teammate knowledge state, agent re-clues rank-1, which P1 already knows, wasting a clue token.
